ic_name: MIPI DSI v1.01.00 (Display Serial Interface, MIPI Alliance)
test_cases_present: partial — DSI v1.01.00 defines detailed compliance behaviors (packet formats, ECC + Checksum algorithms, BTA, EoTp, Tearing Effect, video timing) and the Acknowledge-and-Error-Report mechanism, but is not a self-contained testbench; the formal conformance suite is operated by MIPI Alliance.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Power-up T_INIT sequencing: host drives LP-11 ≥ t_POR + T_INIT_SLAVE + T_INTERNAL_DELAY; peripheral powers up in RX-Stop, ignores Link until T_INIT_SLAVE elapses.
HS Entry sequence (inherited from D-PHY): LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS-0 → Sync 8'b00011101 → packet stream.
HS Exit: HS-Trail → LP-11.
EoTp Short Packet (DT=0x08, payload=0x0F0F, ECC=0x01, VC=0) — verify detection regardless of HS or LP transmission mode; verify EoTp NOT sent on LP transmissions.
EoTp interoperability: enable/disable mechanism allows interoperability with DSI v1.0 peripherals.
Short Packet decode: DI + Data0 + Data1 + ECC = 4 bytes; verify all processor-sourced and peripheral-sourced Short Packet Data Types.
Long Packet decode: DI + WC LS + WC MS + ECC + WC payload + 2-byte Checksum = 6..65541 bytes.
Header ECC: Hamming-modified (24,8); verify single-bit correction and 2-bit detection; verify P6 and P7 transmitted as 0.

Long Packet Checksum: 16-bit CRC poly x^16+x^12+x^5+1, init 0xFFFF, LSB-first; verify Annex B test-data CRCs (gpcTestData0=0x00 → 0x0F87, gpcTestData1=0x01 → 0x1E0E, gpcTestData2 24-byte → 0xE569, gpcTestData3 24-byte → 0x00F0).
Long Packet Checksum special case: zero-byte payload → Checksum = 0xFFFF; peripheral without Checksum capability → Checksum = 0x0000.
Multi-Lane interleave: byte k → lane (k mod N); verify N = 1, 2, 3, 4; verify SoT in parallel + EoT possibly one byte earlier on some Lanes when WC not multiple of N.
Video Mode: Non-Burst with Sync Pulses — verify VSS/VSE/HSS/HSE Sync Event Short Packets with BLLP / HSA / HBP / RGB / HFP packet sequence per §8.11.2.
Video Mode: Non-Burst with Sync Events — verify VSS+HSS only (no VSE/HSE); peripheral regenerates sync widths.
Video Mode: Burst — verify time-compressed RGB packets and BLLP gap; verify LP transition in HBP/HFP for power saving.

Video Mode pixel formats (mandatory for host, at least one for peripheral): 16-bpp RGB565 (DT=0x0E), 18-bpp RGB666 Packed (DT=0x1E, 9 bytes per 4 pixels), 18-bpp RGB666 Loosely Packed (DT=0x2E, 3 bytes per pixel), 24-bpp RGB888 (DT=0x3E, 3 bytes per pixel).

Command Mode peripheral: DCS Short Write 0-param (0x05) / 1-param (0x15); DCS Read no-param (0x06); DCS Long Write / write_LUT (0x39); DCS Short Read Response 1 byte (0x21) / 2 bytes (0x22); DCS Long Read Response (0x1C).
Generic Short WRITE 0/1/2 param (0x03/0x13/0x23) and READ 0/1/2 param (0x04/0x14/0x24); Generic Short Read Response 1/2 byte (0x11/0x12); Generic Long Read Response (0x1A).
Sync Event packets DT[5:0] = xx0001 → V Sync Start (0x01) / V Sync End (0x11) / H Sync Start (0x21) / H Sync End (0x31).
Display control: Color Mode Off (0x02) / On (0x12); Shutdown Peripheral (0x22); Turn On Peripheral (0x32); Set Maximum Return Packet Size (0x37).
Null Packet (0x09) and Blanking Packet (0x19) — Long Packets with arbitrary payload used to fill HS without LP transition.
BTA flow: host TurnRequest → BTA escape → peripheral takes bus → peripheral transmits Acknowledge / Error Report / Read Response → peripheral BTA → host bus.
Acknowledge Trigger Message: peripheral sends single byte 0x21 in LP Escape after non-Read command with no errors.

Acknowledge and Error Report Short Packet (DT=0x02 reverse): 4-byte format with 16-bit Error Report carrying SoT/SoT Sync/EoT Sync/Escape Entry/LP TX Sync/HS RX Timeout/False Control/ECC Single/ECC Multi/Checksum/DT Not Recognized/VC ID Invalid/Invalid TX Length/Protocol Violation.
Error accumulation + clearing: errors accumulate across multiple transmissions until BTA; cleared in peripheral upon report.
Multi-bit ECC error response: peripheral does NOT execute command and shall send only Acknowledge and Error Report (no read data).
Single-bit ECC error response on Read: peripheral sends requested Read Response followed by Acknowledge and Error Report in the SAME LP transmission.
Tearing Effect: BTA-without-command → peripheral sends LP Escape trigger byte 0x5D (LSB-first 10111010) → BTA back to host; verify 0x5D is reserved for TE only.
Set Maximum Return Packet Size default = 1 at power-on; verify peripherals with unidirectional DSI ignore 0x37.

Contention recovery (Annex A): inject LP High Fault / LP Low Fault; verify Case 1 (both detect), Case 2 (only host detects), Case 3 (only peripheral detects); verify Reset Entry command exits contention without hard reset.
Required timers exercised: HRX_TO, HTX_TO, LTX-P_TO, LRX-H_TO, optional TA_TO, optional PR_TO; verify LRX-H_TO > LTX-P_TO ordering.
Reserved Data Type codes: DT[3:0] = 0b0000 or 0b1111 shall NOT be used; receiver shall flag DSI DT Not Recognized.
Endian: bytes LSB-first within byte; multi-byte WC / Checksum / read-response data LS byte first.
Display Resolution compliance: host implements one or more of QQVGA / QCIF / QCIF+ / QVGA / CIF / CIF+ / (1/2)VGA / (2/3)VGA / VGA / WVGA / SVGA / XVGA (per Table 23).
